headline: Long-read sequencing workflows target HIV resistance, RNA isoforms, and m6A methylation
label: Long Read Sequencing Pipelines
summary: Long-read platforms are now paired with calibrated analysis frameworks and clinical pipelines for variant and modification detection.
synthesis: The dominant thread across these items is the maturation of long-read sequencing into analysis workflows with explicit validation or calibration. NanoHIV-DR implements a Nextflow pipeline for HIV-1 drug resistance profiling from Oxford Nanopore reads, combining consensus-based and read-level variant detection. A study of PacBio Kinnex long-read RNA-seq compares it with short-read sequencing for Mendelian disorder diagnosis in 50 individuals, alongside a new bioinformatics pipeline for isoform analysis. A calibrated framework for nanopore direct RNA sequencing benchmarks Dorado versions for m6A calling against GLORI and proposes stringent filtering, reporting cell-specific m6A proportions at conserved sites. What is new is the emphasis on reproducible, benchmarked pipelines applied to clinical and epitranscriptomic questions. The items differ in biological scope, and the shared element is methodological rather than a common biological finding.
